name: hand-limit-10
description: THE HAND LIMIT AT 10 (02/09/2026, RE-POINTED 03/09/2026). ⚠️ WRITTEN AS THE TIGHTER ARM AGAINST A SHIPPED 12 AND IT IS NOW A LOOSE ARM: the shipped limit is 7. Read every tightening sentence below as its opposite. The tighter arm that brackets a number nobody has measured: 12 was chosen as roughly three turns of accumulation above the 4-card opening hand, and there is no evidence behind it beyond the fact that it bounds the enumerator. This arm asks whether the limit should be doing more work than that. WHAT TO READ, IN THIS ORDER: (1) THE BONUS MIX, four ways - Draw 1 / visit a neighbour / visit yourself / slot unspent. The whole design argument for a hand limit is that it puts a DIMINISHING RETURN on drawing, and the free bonus Draw 1 is the move that a no-limit game made strictly dominant (it beat a neighbour visit 3:1 with the limit gone). If tightening to 10 moves the visit share up, the limit is pricing the hook and the shipped 12 is too loose. (2) The median and maximum hand size - if the max sits well under 10 the rule is inert at both values and the arm is measuring nothing. (3) The DISCARD rate at the turn boundary: a limit that bites every turn is a tax on drawing rather than a ceiling on hoarding, and a rising discard count is what that looks like. (4) Game length and the delivery clock, because cards are what a delivery is paid in and a tighter hand is a slower barn. A CAVEAT ON THE INSTRUMENT: the end-of-turn discard is a C(hand, excess) enumeration, so a tighter limit is also cheaper to run - do not read a speed difference between the arms as a design result. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace were removed with the delivery spaces. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level.
